_comment: Explicit country perimeter for ASPI Quiz geo questions. Defined from official ISO 3166-1 / UN M49 code lists, NOT from Wikidata's P31 class hierarchy — that hierarchy is unreliable as a perimeter definition (it classes Gibraltar, a British Overseas Territory, as a sovereign state, while omitting the Cook Islands and Niue, which are states). Every entry must have an official ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code AND a UN M49 numeric code. See DECISIONS.md.
_criterion: official ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 + UN M49 numeric code, and is a state rather than a dependency

_excluded.XKS/XKX: Kosovo — no official ISO 3166-1 code and no M49 code; Wikidata says XKS, the World Bank says XKX, neither is official
_excluded.GIB: Gibraltar — British Overseas Territory, not a state; also absent from both topology resolutions
_excluded.ESH: Western Sahara — disputed, no recognised government exercising control

extra.note: Holy See — UN permanent observer state
State of Palestine — UN permanent observer state
Taiwan — lost UN seat in 1971; retains ISO 3166-1 TWN and M49 158
Cook Islands — self-governing state in free association with New Zealand; WHO/UNESCO member
Niue — self-governing state in free association with New Zealand; WHO/UNESCO member
